title: The Low Tide
hook: The beach house had one note on the back door: when the tide goes out at night, you'll see footprints in the sand. Don't follow them.
lines: The beach house I rented for the winter had a note taped inside the back door.
When the tide goes out at night, you'll see footprints in the sand. Don't follow them.
The first night, I watched from the deck as the water pulled back... farther than I'd ever seen.
And there they were. Bare footprints, starting at the bottom of my steps... walking straight out into the dark.
Every night, the same prints. Same path. Always ending where the water used to be.
On the fourth night, I walked down... and set my bare foot beside the first one.
It was a perfect match. Same size. Same crooked toe.
Then, from far out on the flats... someone called my name.
It was my own voice. Calm. Patient. Telling me to hurry.
I ran back up the steps, locked the door, and didn't sleep.
At sunrise, the tide was back in. The sand was smooth again.
Except for one new set of footprints... coming up out of the water.
They climbed my steps... and stopped at the back door.
The note was still there. Same words... but now, it was in my handwriting.
